headword: {口|くち}コミ{評判|ひょうばん}

definitions.explanation: A reputation formed through personal recommendations, online reviews, and informal evaluations passed between people. Extremely common in modern Japanese consumer culture, especially for restaurants, products, and services.

examples.japanese: {口|くち}コミ{評判|ひょうばん}がいい{店|みせ}。
examples.english: A shop with good word-of-mouth reviews.

examples.japanese: ネットの{口|くち}コミ{評判|ひょうばん}を{参考|さんこう}にして{選|えら}んだ。
examples.english: I chose it based on the online reviews.

examples.japanese: この{商品|しょうひん}は{口|くち}コミ{評判|ひょうばん}がとても{高|たか}く、すぐに{売|う}り{切|き}れてしまった。
examples.english: This product had very high word-of-mouth ratings and sold out quickly.

notes:
Compound of {口|くち}コミ (word of mouth; reviews) + {評判|ひょうばん} (reputation; reviews). {口|くち}コミ itself is a blend of {口|くち} (mouth) + コミュニケーション (communication), though it is now a standalone word. In modern usage, {口|くち}コミ often refers to online reviews as much as spoken recommendations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {口|くち}コミ{評判|ひょうばん}が{良|よ}い: to have good reviews
- {口|くち}コミ{評判|ひょうばん}を{調|しら}べる: to check the reviews
- {口|くち}コミ{評判|ひょうばん}で{広|ひろ}まる: to spread through word of mouth

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {口|くち}コミ: word of mouth; reviews — the base term, used alone more often in casual speech
- {評判|ひょうばん}: reputation; fame — the general concept of public opinion about something
- レビュー: review — the loanword, used especially for online product and service reviews
